name: BanglaDigit: Research Benchmark for Handwritten Bengali Digit Recognition
description: A high-quality handwritten Bengali (Bangla) digit dataset consisting of 80,000 total samples across two structurally consistent variants: BanglaDigit-20k (20,000 samples) and BanglaDigit-60k (60,000 samples). Collected on a capacitive touchscreen tablet from native Bengali writers to avoid optical compression artifacts.
